category_definitions.MEASURED: Directly recorded from physical sensor or instrument at the time of acquisition.
category_definitions.DECLARED: Reported by the source operator or facility manager without direct sensor verification.
category_definitions.INFERRED: Estimated or computed from other available data. Must NOT be used as ground truth.
category_definitions.NOT_AVAILABLE: No evidence of any kind exists for this field.

metadata_provenance_taxonomy.rule: Never silently convert INFERRED or DECLARED values into MEASURED values. Never convert NOT_AVAILABLE to any positive claim. Planned target values are not DECLARED unless confirmed by a site operator in writing.

planned_value_prohibition.rule: planned.* fields must never be used in: perception evaluation, uncertainty calibration, OOD classification, geometry metrics, statistical analysis, or performance claims.
planned_value_prohibition.rationale: Planned camera specifications are engineering targets. Actual optics, mounting, and geometry must be measured on-site.

geometry_metadata.rule: Do not assume planarity. Do not force a homography when floor geometry is not demonstrated planar via ground survey.

audit_notes: Camera hardware specifications, intrinsic and extrinsic matrices, and optical parameters cannot be populated without physical site deployment and direct measurement.
